# Phase 1: EXPLORATORY tolerance sensitivity (filter OFF, validation layouts)

**Exploratory only. The study tolerances stay 0.10 m (centroid to goal) and 0.10 m (mean slot error); nothing here changes them.** Generated by `scripts/phase1_tables.py`. A trial counts as GOAL under a looser pair (goal tol, formation tol) if, at some period before its recorded end, both criteria held (collision still beats goal in the same period). This is exact for tolerances >= 0.10 m, because the trajectory up to that period is the one recorded. Tighter tolerances cannot be evaluated from these runs.
